title: Tech Note: Key Value Pairs Using Objects vs. Arrays
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The core recommendation — prefer 4D objects over parallel array pairs for key/value storage — remains valid and has only strengthened over time as 4D's object and collection support matured; the specific commands shown (C_OBJECT, OB SET) are classic-era syntax that has since been supplemented by newer typed declarations and dot-notation object literals, but the underlying advice still holds.
related_updates: 4D added native object literal syntax (New object(), dot notation) and later typed `var` declarations (v19+) that make working with objects even more convenient than the OB SET commands shown here
4D classes (introduced later) offer a further structured alternative for key/value-like data with behavior attached
